name: ReadWithMe - Accessible Reader
description: An empathetic, WCAG-minded reading assistant for dyslexic readers and users with visual stress. Adjusts typography and tint, adds a cursor-tracking Focus Window, a non-destructive Calm Mode, light/dark mode for webpages, on-page quick toggles, a syllable/jargon helper, a cursor Read-Aloud (TTS) feature, and an in-page AI reading copilot.
